evidence.excerpt: Cyber Insurance Underwriting Guide > 4. Referral Criteria The submission must be referred to a senior underwriter if any of the following applies: - Annual revenue exceeds CAD 50 million. - The applicant has experienced a ransomware incident in the past 36 months. - The applicant does not use multi-factor authentication for remote access. - The applicant operates in cryptocurrency exchange, online gambling, or critical infrastructure. - The requested aggregate limit exceeds CAD 5 million.

Cyber Insurance Underwriting Guide > 6. Cyber Coverage Reminder Underwriting requirements, referral criteria, and security controls are risk-selection criteria. They do not by themselves determine whether a specific cyber event is covered, excluded, or subject to a policy condition. Coverage must be determined by the applicable policy wording and endorsements.

Insurance Exclusions Reference > 3. Cyber Insurance Underwriting Restrictions The following exposures require referral and may be declined depending on the complete submission: - Cryptocurrency exchanges. - Online gambling businesses. - Critical infrastructure operators. - Organizations with a ransomware incident in the previous 36 months. - Organizations without multi-factor authentication for remote access. These underwriting restrictions are not policy exclusions.
